newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end up 3.81 pct at 66.751 point.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end up 3.81 pct at 66.751 point.

text.p: Shanghai B share index rose 3.81 percent or 2.452 points to close at 66.751 points on Thursday on buying by domestic investors encouraged by a rise in the A share market, brokers said.

Shanghai A share index rose 3.23 percent or 30.105 points to 962.878 on Thursday, with investors encouraged by an official denial of rumours Beijing would adopt a three-day settlement system instead of next-day settlement, brokers said.
Brokers said that foreign investors were absent from the B market today because of the Christmas holiday, leaving the market to domestic investors.
The rally was led by real estate developer Shanghai Lujiazui on support buying by institutions after it listed an additional 60 million B shares, brokers said.
Volume was dull, with trading of 15.8 million shares worth $7.3 million. Of 42 B shares, 40 traded, with 34 up, two flat and four down.
Lujiazui was the second biggest gainer and the most actively traded, rising $0.106 or 8.64 percent to $1.332, on volume of 2.2 million shares.

"Most investors had not expected market barometer Lujiazui to perform so strongly after it listed 60 additional million B shares today, which encouraged individual buyers, with overseas institutions absent," one brokers said.

"With overseas investors coming back gradually tomorrow, the market will become more active, with selling pressure expected at high levels," another broker said. "So the potential for further rises is limited."
Textile firm Worldbest was the star on an announcement it would take over a plastics firm, with institutions with large positions taking advantage to push the price up, traders said.
It jumped $0.034 or 9.44 percent to $0.394, on volume of 1.6 million shares.
Shanghai A share continued their rebound but the potential for further rises will be limited, with sentiment still cautious after an official crackdown last Monday, brokers said.
Trading volume was 512.1 million shares worth 4.1 billion yuan. The SSE 30 index put on 41.262 points or 1.71 percent to 2461.001 points.
